summary_en: Autobacs Seven executed an off-market purchase of up to 1,000,000 shares at 1,562 yen per share on November 5, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3. This execution is against an authorized framework to acquire up to 2,000,000 shares for a maximum 3,600 million yen through March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Market Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, Autobacs Seven (ticker: 9832) executed an off-market share purchase via ToSTNeT-3 at 1,562 yen per share. The company placed an order for up to 1,000,000 shares at the November 4 closing price of 1,562 yen during the ToSTNeT-3 trading session at 8:45 AM on November 5. The transaction was executed on an order-for-trading-time-only basis.

This execution is part of a broader share buyback framework authorized by the Board of Directors on October 30, 2026. The full framework permits the acquisition of up to 2,000,000 shares for a maximum total of 3,600 million yen during the period from November 2, 2026 through March 31, 2027. The specific execution announced here represents a single block transaction within that larger authorized envelope. Results of the purchase would be disclosed after market close on November 5, 2026. The company noted that market conditions could result in a partial or complete non-execution of the order.
